description: Vertical slice (Vaikor L4/L7/L5): a session record carried in a Vaikor Envelope signed by the Core key, with one Privacy Gateway report per egress and an effective tier display rendered and signed by the Core. Signatures are real Ed25519 over jcs with the RFC 8032 test keys: rfc8032-test-1 is the Core key, rfc8032-test-2 a module key, rfc8032-test-3 the owner key.
